evidence: shapeOf now returns readable only when frontmatterBlock(raw) equals raw[:3+i+5]. Any disagreement falls through to the unreadable scan, which collects every line between the opening rule and the next rule line. A legacy key placed after a line ending in --- but before the closing rule is therefore still seen and counted.
Opening and closing rule lines in the unreadable scan are trimmed of trailing spaces and tabs. The readable rule stays exact, as the commit message says.
The refusal name and reason reuse the single unreadableCauses constant, and the tests assert the new text, so the wording cannot drift.

Pages that were readable before and now disagree with the shared reader are refused instead of rewritten. This is the stated intent and prevents MatchesPage from reading the rewrite as a hand edit, so it is not a regression.

I did not see how carriage returns are stripped in the unreadable scan, since those lines are outside the diff. The closing-line trim does not remove them. This is unchanged from the base, so I report nothing.
